_comment: v0.16 #305 R2 'What the Thicket Keeps', the TALK route end to end -- and the owner of TWO things besides: the witch_hut ROUND TRIP (witch_hollow (1,8) -> hut (4,6) and back to (1,8)) and hut_ward_scrap's LOCKED read. Hunter start off the new price_of_a_favor_reported-gated hub row -> thicket_brief -> thicket_sign -> the reroute option banking herd_rerouted and completing beat 1 -> the hut and its refusal -> the REROUTED report, completing beat 2. The fixture holds NO detect_magic, which is what makes the locked read reachable and the whole-run ward_scrap_read/detected_wardwork absences sound. Zero combat: thicket_line_den is armed by heard_thicket_keeps and left standing.

steps._comment: == GIVE: the hunter (13,10), directly east. First interact = his talk_pool line; second opens riverfarm_hunter. ==
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: Hub with hunter_will_come unbanked and heard_thicket_keeps unbanked: 0 '[Ask him to come with you.]', 1 'Just passing through.', 2 'The deer stopped at the treeline. Why?'. The three report rows are all hidden by their own route counters. Take 2.
thicket_brief: 0 'Show me the sign.', 1 "What's in there?", 2 "I'll look into it.". Take 0.

payload_contains.speaker: The Hunter
payload_contains.text: Here. Hoof marks come up, stop, turn, and go back, all along one line you can't see from standing. Not one print past it in a mile of treeline. Whatever's holding them isn't teeth. Teeth leave a mess.

steps._comment: thicket_sign: 0 'Then we move the fences, not the deer.' banks herd_rerouted (goto thicket_rerouted, not end), 1 "I'll walk the line myself.". Take 0.

== THE HUT ROUND TRIP (this script owns it) == witch_hut_door sits at witch_hollow (1,7) and is blocked, so 'move up' from (1,8) faces it without stepping. [1,7]/[1,8] sit outside the pinned cottage cluster entirely, so witch_cottage_reachability's own cells are untouched.

== THE WARD SCRAP, LOCKED (this script owns the negative) == hut_ward_scrap carries requires_skill detect_magic, and THIS fixture holds no detect_magic anywhere, so interactions.gd takes use_skill's unknown branch: SKILL_UNKNOWN + locked_toast. The skill_hint_toast arm is unreachable from here by construction -- it only fires when the required skill is already KNOWN, which is thicket_keeps_skill's case.

payload_contains.text: A palm-sized shard of grey stone on the shelf, cut along one edge with marks you cannot read.
A palm-sized shard of grey stone on the shelf, cut along one edge with marks you cannot read.

steps._comment: Whole-run, and sound as a whole-run assertion precisely because this run never casts the skill at all. assert_event_absent has no window (test_driver.gd:520-522 scans the entire run), so a 'not banked YET' assertion is impossible -- which is why the positive lives in a separate script.
The scrap is not a fifth wardwork site; nothing on this map may bank that counter.
== BACK OUT == witch_hut_exit (4,7) -> witch_hollow (1,8), the same cell the entry approached from. Both arrival directions for witch_hut are now asserted.
== REPORT == same waking, pool spent, so one interact opens riverfarm_hunter directly.

Hub post-reroute: heard_thicket_keeps hides the start row and herd_rerouted opens the REROUTED report. 0 '[Ask him to come with you.]', 1 'Just passing through.', 2 "Fences are moved. The herd's got its road.". Take 2.
